Try:
  call airk_status
  help airk_search

This is an AIRK tools console, not an operating-system shell.
Calls read the existing index; they do not index or download models.
JSON is entered directly without shell quoting. File paths may contain spaces.

airk> capabilities
  Check native formats, explicitly provisioned local model/OCR/code-provider adapters and their limits before planning exploration. Works before indexing. Reports available capabilities, not whether optional providers or this collection are ready. Terse replies summarize Workbench operation schemas; response_mode=full includes them. read_guidance lists bounded reason/action vocabulary; its suggestions execute no tools. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits, readiness diagnosis or unexpected results.
changes
  Inspect bounded observed indexed changes since an exact token and validate remembered evidence. Supply since or selectors. Check independent coverage and freshness; this does not verify live source. Consume every needed cursor page before advancing the baseline. index-current describes the index, not live files. Baselines retain bounded metadata across up to 64 publications/24 hours; pressure can advance explicit coverage floors. Moves are content-based candidates, not proof of filesystem intent. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits, readiness diagnosis or unexpected results.
code_facts
  Retrieve code facts when definition navigation needs signatures, scopes, written types, call/framework candidates or symbol IDs for relationships. Exact name is default, including qualified names and terminal native call method names; name_match=suffix/contains explicitly broadens case-sensitive simple/qualified names. A durable symbol_key is exclusive of filters, matching and count options. Compact discovery is the default under Agent Lean; expand selected candidates with compact=false. Cursors bind the exact query/publication; include_count reports bounded precision, not a guessed total. Check basis/coverage; native syntax and optional source-bound producer assertions do not prove resolved calls or runtime behavior. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits.
context
  Expand a search/fact hit with bounded neighboring indexed lines around its line coordinate. PDF/DOCX/PPTX lines are extracted-text coordinates; keep the request within one original page/block/slide. Evidence reflects the last successful index. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits, readiness diagnosis or unexpected results.
diagnostics
  Troubleshoot AIRK: full published coverage, runtime versions and process identities, scoped job/queue state, worker progress, source watcher and sampled waits. The MCP frontend adds configured query_concurrency from admission. Read-only; may be slower and larger than status. Use status for routine readiness checks. response_mode=full detail is always included; does not start indexing or repair.
document_facts
  Find repository requirements, dates, features, architecture/design/decision language, headings, configuration keys and asset facts. Select a durable document_key alone, or filter by exact kind, language/profile, literal path prefix or statement/name substring. Prose cues include heading context, written bounds/units and modality; they are evidence candidates, not inferred obligations. Documents retain original locations; explicitly published local OCR evidence carries its own provenance and recognition limitations. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits, readiness diagnosis or unexpected results.
file_info
  Check a file's indexed language/profile, extraction method, syntax quality, hash and line basis before interpreting evidence. Distinguishes source lines from extracted document coordinates; does not compare the live file for freshness. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits, readiness diagnosis or unexpected results.
help
  Explain AIRK usage, CLI commands, tool schemas and Explorer workflows. Omit selectors for an overview; query searches bundled guidance, topic_id reads a UI/engine guide, topic reads native guidance, command reads CLI help, and tool reads a public tool schema. Native guides retain prefixed CLI/evidence compatibility names; tools/list and tool selectors describe the unified public catalog. Returns documentation, never project evidence or live health.
imports
  Inspect written import/use/include declarations by indexed language/profile, literal path prefix and optional name. Omitted name_match keeps the existing case-insensitive substring behavior; explicit exact/suffix/contains is case-sensitive. Use cursor continuation and optional include_count for bounded count precision. These are syntax candidates, not a resolved, transitive or dynamic dependency graph. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits.
list_files
  Discover indexed files before choosing paths for outlines or reads. Filter by literal relative-path prefix, not glob; count and bytes are bounded. Lists the snapshot inventory, not all live workspace files or indexing coverage. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits, readiness diagnosis or unexpected results.
outline
  Read one indexed file's structure in file order: imports, definitions, call candidates and document facts with locations. This is read-only source evidence; suggest_view proposes an Explorer screen instead. Takes one exact path and pages with cursor; a first page may not reach a known definition, so prefer scoped symbols/code_facts for that. Compact minimal navigation is default; compact=false expands facts and IDs. Bounded or empty output is not a whole-file or complete-language claim. Use response_mode=full for provenance audits.
parse
  Prepare or execute a bounded read-only AIRK evidence plan. Supply schema airk.parse.request/1, mode prepare or execute, and exactly one of text, recipe, plan. Explicit plans contain steps {id,tool,args,bind}; public operation names only. Bindings use earlier step IDs and named selectors. At most 6 steps, 12 reads, a 30-second budget checked between reads, 512 KiB. Learned text in this review build returns an inert proposed plan with needs_input; review its arguments and resubmit the explicit plan to execute. Other uncertainty, partial coverage and failures stay explicit. No writes, commands, management, recursive plans or agent reasoning. Works without Explorer. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits; raw inner evidence retains its full kernel representation.
query_scope
  Discover only the connection's reviewed Project/index grant. Projects, indexes and sources have bounded pages and revision-bound continuations. recommendations returns bounded metadata-only advice and catalog-checked scope instructions, with optional explicit selection/situation and no cursor or limit. Legacy connections report configuration_required. Never enumerates the machine library, queries evidence or opens sources.
read_file
  Inspect a specific code or document excerpt after locating it. Read an inclusive 1-based indexed line range from an inventory path; this is the last successful snapshot, not a live filesystem read. For PDF/DOCX/PPTX, use extracted lines within one page/block/slide. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits, readiness diagnosis or unexpected results.
references
  Locate exact-case whole-identifier matching lines in retained indexed text, including definitions, strings and comments. Markdown, HTML, scripts and source can all match; scope by path_prefix, exact indexed language or metadata-based evidence_kind for impact work. These are textual candidates, never resolved references. Omit new paging options for legacy index ordering; explicit order=index/path/code_first, filters, cursor, include_files or include_count select bounded pageable scanning. Page file summaries/counts disclose their scope and matching-line unit; incomplete scans never imply an exact corpus total. Consume continuation and check truncation/coverage before concluding no impact; verify live source before edits. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits.
relationships
  Investigate bounded incoming/outgoing structural candidates with path scope and 1..3 hops. Written targets such as Type::new or obj.method identify textual caller candidates; a struct symbol ID alone does not prove a complete caller set. Verified type/method suggestions, when available, are navigation candidates rather than resolved associations. Agent Lean/Rich Structure retain supported calls; SCIP assertions are not calls. Check coverage and truncation: absent edges never prove no impact. Use response_mode=full for provenance/coverage audits.
search
  Find concepts, code or documents; prose/comments and source can rank together. For a named type/function, prefer symbols first, scoped references for textual uses, then bounded read_file; search supplements that investigation. Scope by literal path_prefix, exact indexed language, metadata-based evidence_kind or exclude_path_prefix; documents alone do not prove application behavior. Omitted mode retains saved hybrid/vector policy; explicit lexical normalizes punctuation and quotes into AND terms; quotes do not enable phrase matching. Lexical candidates use stable-id order, not relevance ranking. Eligible Default search can return lexical evidence during a helper outage; execution records served mode and semantic incompleteness. Explicit vector/hybrid and saved RequireComplete refuse helper outages. Vector/hybrid need the indexed local model. semantic=true aliases vector. Bounded native-definition pointers may accompany identifiers without changing ranking. Focused cited snippets are default; full_chunks requests whole indexed chunks. Read guidance for returned limitations; empty matches alone establish no cause. Check readiness/truncation and use response_mode=full for provenance audits.
status
  Quick version, health and project-index check: counts, publication, source-update state, semantic readiness and configured query_concurrency at frontend admission. Obtain before broad evidence fan-out; lightweight does not mean exempt from bounded admission. Completed same-authority observations superseded by scalar invalidation return successfully with status_observation.superseded and their original publication/time. Successful snapshots may be cached for five seconds; observed_unix_ms, cache_age_ms and cached disclose their age. Allows up to ten seconds for shared cold runtime setup, followed by a two-second observation budget; expiry reports unknown readiness and null evidence. Always skips process diagnostics and editor probes. Call diagnostics for detailed work, runtime versions and Explorer attachment. Counts are saved evidence, not proof that live files match. Does not start indexing or repair.
symbols
  Locate supported written code definitions before broad text search. Exact name is default: Session does not match OwnerSession. Explicit name_match=suffix/contains matches simple/qualified names case-sensitively; omit name to list within indexed language/profile or literal path_prefix. Keep compact discovery for candidates, then request compact=false on a selected scope for rich IDs/details. Consume cursor pages; include_count reports bounded count precision. Does not resolve dynamic/cross-file names. Use code_facts for additional fact categories and response_mode=full for provenance audits.
draft_search
  Propose a Search › Query form, or a matching reviewed combined Workbench Search form when explicit Project selectors are supplied (lexical, vector or hybrid; literal path prefix; limit; byte budget). Combined selectors must match the captured session and are never applied to a legacy form. The user decides whether to run it. The draft goes to the Suggestions Inbox of the attached Explorer window and waits for the user; nothing is applied, saved or run. Bodies are limited to 16384 bytes; unknown fields are refused.
draft_strategy
  Propose a Strategies › Studio draft from a core template (template_id such as airk.core/bug) and/or custom steps. Steps use only these operators: airk.status, airk.capabilities, airk.search, airk.listFiles, airk.fileInfo, airk.symbols, airk.imports, airk.codeFacts, airk.relationships, airk.references, airk.documentFacts, airk.outline, airk.readFile, airk.changes, host.hashSavedFiles, core.dedupe, core.sort, core.clip, core.cite, core.renderPrompt; arguments bind only ${params.NAME} and ${scope.pathPrefix}, and fan-out steps name an earlier step as input. The draft goes to the Suggestions Inbox of the attached Explorer window and waits for the user; nothing is applied, saved or run. Bodies are limited to 16384 bytes; unknown fields are refused.
draft_plan
  Propose a Strategies › Planner draft: tasks T1, T2… with dependencies and acceptance notes, and an optional relative .md path hint. The user saves the file; there is no save field. The draft goes to the Suggestions Inbox of the attached Explorer window and waits for the user; nothing is applied, saved or run. Bodies are limited to 16384 bytes; unknown fields are refused.
list_templates
  Discover installed core strategy templates, their ids, versions, purposes and runnable/preview availability. Offline, bounded and paginated; never runs a template.
get_template
  Read one complete installed template: exact parameters/defaults, steps, budgets, instructions and operator argument contracts. Includes runnable/preview availability. No execution.
validate_draft
  Dry-run the same strict draft validation as submission, without Inbox admission, rate consumption or idempotency reservation. If a trusted window is attached, also check binding, target revision and existing idempotency conflicts. Offline validation never proves live applicability.
proposal_status
  Read proposal status, machine-readable reason, admitted/current/applied draft revisions and expiry. Applied means copied into an Explorer draft; executed is always false. Returns no body.
get_handoff
  Read only a complete Studio prompt or Planner task explicitly shared by the user. Requires its expiring opaque token. Returns revision, workspace binding, evidence publication when present, text and SHA-256. Draft/binding/publication changes revoke access. No general draft access or execution.
suggest_view
  Propose an Explorer screen for the user to open or prefill, including Review and Management guidance. Returns a proposal receipt, never source evidence. Routes such as code/outline name UI pages, not the evidence tools. The user applies the suggestion; it never runs a query, test or management action.
projects
  List only the project bindings configured for this AIRK connection and its default. Use these identifiers to scope evidence and Explorer requests; does not register or switch projects.

Use: airk tools help <tool>
Or in the tools console: help <tool>
airk> search
Find concepts, code or documents; prose/comments and source can rank together. For a named type/function, prefer symbols first, scoped references for textual uses, then bounded read_file; search supplements that investigation. Scope by literal path_prefix, exact indexed language, metadata-based evidence_kind or exclude_path_prefix; documents alone do not prove application behavior. Omitted mode retains saved hybrid/vector policy; explicit lexical normalizes punctuation and quotes into AND terms; quotes do not enable phrase matching. Lexical candidates use stable-id order, not relevance ranking. Eligible Default search can return lexical evidence during a helper outage; execution records served mode and semantic incompleteness. Explicit vector/hybrid and saved RequireComplete refuse helper outages. Vector/hybrid need the indexed local model. semantic=true aliases vector. Bounded native-definition pointers may accompany identifiers without changing ranking. Focused cited snippets are default; full_chunks requests whole indexed chunks. Read guidance for returned limitations; empty matches alone establish no cause. Check readiness/truncation and use response_mode=full for provenance audits.

Save arguments as query.json, then run with your collection options:
  airk tools call airk_search --args-file query.json
Inside the tools console:
  call airk_search --args-file query.json
  call airk_search {"include_status":false,"limit":10,"max_bytes":8192,"query":"<query>","semantic":false,"verification":"report","verification_deadline_ms":2000,"verification_max_bytes":16777216,"verification_max_sources":8}

Explicit vector search (requires a published model/index and discloses partial coverage):
  call airk_search {"query":"how is a forgotten password recovered","mode":"vector","limit":5}
Omit mode for the saved collection search policy.
